reviewMethod.wholeSourcePurity: Every candidate was reviewed from full-source 15 fps whole-body and lower-body evidence. Detailed 15 fps sheets were used whenever the coarse overview could hide staggered contacts.
reviewMethod.countPolicy: Only the single clip that passed whole-source purity after targeted ~30 fps re-resolution received a GT. Programmatic motion/centroid signals were used only as timestamp locators; every admitted cycle and long cadence gap was visually reviewed.
reviewMethod.mixedTypePolicy: Any alternate-foot, boxer-step, high-knee, crossover, lateral/non-basic footwork, or mixed subtype anywhere in the source rejects the clip from STANDARD.
reviewMethod.reResolution: g18_c04 was initially over-rejected from blurred 15 fps evidence. Targeted original-frame foot-level review resolved it as synchronized two-foot STANDARD, so the review was corrected rather than preserving the false reject.
